name: Sarah M.
text: This is exactly what I needed to hear. I've been overthinking the paid ads route when I should've been building genuine relationships with early adopters first.

name: Marcus T.
text: The hard part is real - I spent 3 months on networking and content before getting my first 20 customers, but they became my best advocates. Worth every hour.

name: Jennifer K.
text: Question: Does this approach work for B2B SaaS or is it mostly for consumer products? Our sales cycle is longer and I'm not sure how to apply this.

name: David L.
text: Most founders skip it because it's uncomfortable and slow. I get it, but skipping organic growth means you don't really understand your market.

name: Amanda R.
text: Been there, done this with my newsletter. Took 4 months to hit 100 subs organically but conversion rate is way higher than anything I've ever bought.
